entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: An elemental god, living embodiment of Shadowmoor and a symbol of the moon; twin worldsoul of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor with Eirdu.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: Incarnation of the sun and Isilu's counterpart.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane where Isilu and Eirdu wander.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Ruler whose downfall merged the aspects of Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A faerie planeswalker who caused Isilu's rest to be disturbed.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Home plane of the visiting students.

entities.name: Worshipers of Isilu
entities.description: Followers who seek to convert the plane into Shadowmoor.

events.summary: After Oona's downfall, Eirdu and Isilu awaken from the firmament.
events.quote: two great beings awoke from the firmament above the plane

events.summary: Isilu and Eirdu find a balance in which the boundaries change only gradually.
events.quote: Isilu and Eirdu found a balance

events.summary: Oko disturbs Isilu's rest via visiting students from Arcavios, destabilizing the balance.
events.quote: caused Isilu's rest to be disturbed

relations.quote: he is the twin worldsoul of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
many have taken to worshiping these two beings as deities
